name: Lightning Storm
description: A rippling electrical current flows right beneath the transparent coating of this paint, making your tank look like a mobile plasma ball of destruction.
interestingFacts: This paint was only available during the first release of Challenges which lasted from 14th December until 25th January (6 weeks).

Tankers who wear this paint bring a fury to the battlefield only matched in strength by the fiercest tornadoes. If you see someone wearing this paint, it's best to hide in a storm shelter. Or maybe in a different battle entirely.
This paint was added to June Challenge II at tier 23.
